decision: Rename the private parseItem function to parseDecisionRecord
reason:
The old name hides what the private helper returns and makes the nearby call site harder to scan. The rename clarifies one module without changing behavior or its external contract.

No other module imports the helper. Reversing the name would be a local edit with no migration cost.
tradeoff: The diff changes a familiar private identifier for existing contributors.

facets.label: Scope
facets.text: One private function in one file.

decision: Add a makeDecision test helper in collect-adr-context.test.ts
reason:
Several examples repeat the same complete record shape, which obscures the field each test changes. A file-local helper keeps those tests legible while preserving explicit overrides.

The helper is not shared and establishes no production interface. It can be inlined again without affecting other files.
tradeoff: Readers must jump to the top of the test file to see default fixture values.

facets.label: Scope
facets.text: One helper used only by one test file.

decision: Sort one glob result before asserting while Bun issue 18210 remains open
reason:
The upstream glob iterator returns nondeterministic order on one platform, causing a flaky assertion even though the collected set is correct. Sorting at the assertion boundary isolates the workaround to the affected test.

Remove the sort after the upstream issue is fixed and pinned. No production behavior or cross-module contract depends on it.
tradeoff: The workaround can conceal an ordering regression if the test later starts promising order.

facets.label: Temporary
facets.text: The workaround is tied to a known upstream test-only issue.

decision: Write the intermediate refactor snapshot as JSON instead of JSONL
reason:
The temporary snapshot is read once by the migration script and contains a single object, so JSON is easier to inspect during the refactor. The final trail format remains JSONL and no shipped reader sees this file.

The snapshot disappears when the refactor completes. Changing it back affects only the temporary script and its disposable output.
tradeoff: The temporary file differs from the final storage format and could confuse someone inspecting the worktree.

facets.label: Lifetime
facets.text: Disposable artifact used only during one refactor.
